Hi Anand, welcome!  It's great to meet you. Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today.  I’ve reviewed your resume and I'm particularly interested in your projects, especially the Java-based Digital Mall and the GameZork platform.  They showcase a nice range of skills.

To get started, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within software development, and what you're hoping to achieve in your career.

Okay, Anand,  you mentioned your Digital Mall project uses Java and MySQL. Can you walk me through a specific challenge you faced during its development, how you approached solving it, and what you learned from the experience?

Following up on your Digital Mall project,  you mentioned using Data Structures. Can you give me a specific example of how you implemented a data structure to improve the efficiency or functionality of your application, and why you chose that particular structure?

Your GameZork project uses a front-end technology stack of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.  Considering you haven't had professional experience yet, can you describe a situation where you had to debug a particularly tricky front-end issue in GameZork and what your debugging process was?

Anand, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today. I truly appreciate you sharing your experience and skills with us; it's given us valuable insights.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we'll be in touch within [Number] business days to let you know the next steps in the hiring process.  Regardless of the outcome, we wish you all the best in your job search.
